s: red heifer is burned with cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet (cast into the middle of the burning)
q: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

s: Eleazar is a priest
q: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest

s: ashes of the heifer is stored at camp (outside the camp in a clean place)
q: lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place

s: ashes of the heifer is kept for children of Israel (for the congregation, for use in water for cleansing impurity)
q: it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity.

s: ashes of the heifer is a sin offering
q: It is a sin offering.

s: princes (heads of the thousands of Israel) is a princes of the tribes (heads of the thousands of Israel)
q: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

s: princes (heads of the thousands of Israel) member count twelve (princes of Israel, each for his fathers' house)
q: and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

s: census of Israel counts children of Israel (males twenty years and upward able to go to war)
q: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.

s: census of Israel total counted 603,550 (men able to go to war)
q: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

s: census of Israel conducted by Moses (with Aaron)
q: You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

s: census of Israel conducted by Aaron (with Moses)
q: You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

s: census of Israel excludes Levites (commanded by the LORD)
q: Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

s: Reuben counted number 46,500 (men able to go to war)
q: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

s: Reuben is a firstborn of Israel
q: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn

s: Gad counted number 45,650 (men able to go to war)
q: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

s: Levites has role custodians of the Tabernacle of the Testimony (appointed by the LORD)
q: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it.

s: Levites carries tabernacle (Tent of the Testimony) (with all its furnishings)
q: They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

s: Levites encamps around tabernacle (Tent of the Testimony) (so there is no wrath on the congregation)
q: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel.

s: tabernacle (Tent of the Testimony) is taken down and set up by Levites (when it moves or is set up)
q: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up.

s: Nahshon child of Amminadab (son)
q: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

s: Miriam dies at Kadesh (died and was buried there)
q: Miriam died there, and was buried there.

s: Aaron is barred from promised land (because he rebelled against the LORD's word at Meribah)
q: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

s: Eleazar succeeds Aaron (receives Aaron's garments)
q: put them on Eleazar his son.

s: Mount Hor located at border of Edom
q: in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom

s: waters of Meribah of Kadesh is a waters (where Israel strove with the LORD and he was sanctified)
q: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.

s: Edom refuses Israelites (passage through its border)
q: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

s: Israelites mourns Aaron (thirty days)
q: they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

s: Israelites stays at Kadesh (in the wilderness of Zin, first month)
q: The people stayed in Kadesh.

s: Kadesh is a city (at the edge of Edom's border)
q: Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

s: Moses has brother Aaron
q: you, and Aaron your brother

s: Edom is brother of Israelites (as described by Moses' message)
q: “Your brother Israel says:

s: Edom has ruler title king
q: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom

s: Moses loses right to bring the assembly into the promised land (because he did not believe the LORD at Meribah)
q: “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

s: Aaron has son Eleazar
q: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

s: Aaron dies at Mount Hor (on the top of the mountain)
q: Aaron died there on the top of the mountain

s: venomous snakes sent by LORD (among the people as judgment)
q: The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people.

s: Sihon king of the Amorites is a king of the Amorites
q: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites

s: Sihon king of the Amorites rules over Heshbon (Heshbon was his city)
q: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites

s: Heshbon is a city where Israel lived (among the cities of the Amorites)
q: Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

s: children of Israel possesses land of Sihon (from the Arnon to the Jabbok, to Ammon's border)
q: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon

s: Sihon king of the Amorites fought former king of Moab (took all his land to the Arnon)
q: who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

s: Chemosh is god of Moab (Moab called people of Chemosh)
q: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh!

s: Og is a king of Bashan
q: Og the king of Bashan went out against them

s: children of Israel possesses land of Og (after striking him and his people with no survivors)
q: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.

s: bronze serpent (Moses's bronze serpent) made by Moses (set on a pole)
q: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole.

s: bronze serpent (Moses's bronze serpent) has power healing of snakebite (those who looked at it lived)
q: If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.

s: Balak is a king of Moab (at that time)
q: Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

s: Balaam the son of Beor has servants servants (Balaam's two servants) (two)
q: Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

s: Balaam the son of Beor obeys God (will only speak the word God gives)
q: I can’t go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

s: angel of the LORD serves God (the LORD's angel)
q: the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him.

s: donkey (Balaam's donkey) has trait perceives the angel of the LORD (Balaam could not at first)
q: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand

s: donkey (Balaam's donkey) has gender female
q: she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall.

s: children of Israel encamps in plains of Moab (beyond the Jordan at Jericho)
q: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

s: plains of Moab located near Jericho (beyond the Jordan)
q: the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

s: curse of Israel desired by Balak (so he could strike and drive them out)
q: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me.

s: Balak rules Moab (as king)
q: Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

s: Moab fears children of Israel (because they were many)
q: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many.

s: Balaam the son of Beor lives in Pethor (by the River, land of his people)
q: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him

s: children of Israel came out of Egypt
q: there is a people who came out of Egypt.

s: children of Israel is blessed by God (God declares them blessed)
q: You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.

s: Balaam the son of Beor reputation whom he blesses is blessed and whom he curses is cursed (stated by Balak)
q: for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.

s: Balaam the son of Beor owns donkey (Balaam's donkey) (his riding animal)
q: Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today?

s: Balak is a king of Moab
q: the king of Moab from the mountains of the East

s: children of Israel has status blessed by God (blessing cannot be reversed)
q: He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

s: children of Israel has god LORD
q: The LORD his God is with him.

s: children of Israel has leader king (shout of a king among them)
q: The shout of a king is among them.
